notes.title: UPDATE #4 | 11 Newly translated languages, subtitles fix and more...
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone! 

Due to the high interest in the title, I decided to translate the game into 11 languages myself, which wasn't an easy challenge. I ask for your understanding in case of any imperfections in the translations.[/b]

[list]
[*]Added 11 new languages, including [b]French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, and Turkish[/b], and the entire UI has been adapted and revised for localization in these languages.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed disappearing subtitles in the first cutscene.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Accelerated overly slow crouching.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Minor UI and other small fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE #3 | Cameras system overhaul, bug fixes and more...
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support with [b]Supernormal[/b]. I decided to surprise you with an update that addresses the most frequently mentioned issues on Discord, namely:

[list]
[*] Overhauled the entire camera system for improved controller compatibility and ease of use.
[*] Resolved an issue where players could get stuck in the Voice Commands menu while on the computer.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the interact icon to appear when not looking at an interactable object.
[*] Implemented various minor bug fixes.
[*] Added a trailer for the upcoming game [b]Supernatural[/b] at the end of the current game.
[*] Corrected non-functional social media links in the pause and main menu.
[*] Updated control schemes in the pause and main menus for clarity.
[/list]

notes.title: SUPERNATURAL COMING OUT SOON - WISHLIST NOW
UPDATE #2 | Voice Commands Menu, Improved Microphone and more...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I would like to thank you all for playing the game and all the positive comments. Due to this month being both very challenging and pivotal for me, I've decided to release a new update and discount the game by 20% for the rest of the month. In this update, you'll find:


[b]- Added the voice recognition menu and now if you doesn't have a microphone, you can use this drop down menu to use a voice command instead.

- More optimization.

- Improved microphone picking up noises.

- Addded additional support for a "C" button to crouch.

- Adjusted walking speed to be a little bit faster than before.[/b]

Additionally, I've left something special for the very end, after the game credits in this update. I hope you'll be as excited as I am. If you have any feedback, suggestions for future updates, or any questions, feel free to join us on Discord[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/m3CkAaVAr3][b]CLICK HERE TO JOIN DISCORD[/b][/url]

notes.title: UPDATE #1 | Voice Recognition, Saves and more...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the game premiere was something incredible for me. Most of you enjoyed playing it, which makes me extremely happy. Some of you experienced issues with certain features, so I immediately got to work to improve them. The update includes: 


[b]- Voice recognition has been updated and now detects speech much more accurately.

- Fixed a bug where after autsave and restarting the game, you couldn't interact with the laptop.

- More highlighted moment when the game performs the only autosave.

- UI message indicating that you can skip the initial cutscene.

- Completely rewritten system for starting a new game and resuming after autosave. From now on, you can start your experience anew at any moment from the main menu or continue your journey after a one-time autosave.[/b]

I hope that thanks to this update, you will be willing to play the game again if you had any issues with it before this update. Don't forget to join our Discord, where you can share what you liked, what you would like to see in future updates, and what I can improve. See you on Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/m3CkAaVAr3][b]CLICK HERE TO JOIN DISCORD[/b][/url]
